description:
Clayer is a premium natural healing clay recovery brand founded in 2016 by professional skateboarder Thibault “Tibs” Parise after a serious knee injury forced him to look for real, non-chemical solutions.

We specialize in 100% natural, heavy-metal-free, Ecocert-certified healing clay products designed for fast recovery, inflammation reduction, and skin detoxification — especially after exposure to chlorine, sweat, dirt, or injury.

Our current core line includes:

  • Healing Clay Mask (classic bentonite-based)
  • First-Aid Clay Paste (targeted spot treatment)
  • Recovery Clay Powder (mixable for larger areas or baths)
  • French Green Clay Detox products

All products are athlete-tested, used by elite sports professionals, medical teams, and people who demand real results instead of temporary relief.Website: https://clayerworld.com

What makes us different
Most “natural” clays on the market are either:

  • Low-quality, inconsistent, or contaminated with heavy metals
  • Slow-acting (1–2 hours application time)
  • Generic with no real performance backing

Clayer is built differently:

  • Certified non-toxic (Ecocert) and heavy-metal-free — lab tested
  • Delivers visible results in 15–30 minutes (4× faster than standard clays)
  • Backed by real-world use: professional athletes, medical teams (including work with SPRT Therapy, Motus PT, MLB, NFL-adjacent staff, Olympians, and world champions in MMA, surfing, rugby)
  • Focused only on recovery and healing — not diluted with dozens of unrelated personal care items
  • Founder is still actively involved as an athlete and ambassador — this is not a faceless brand

We solve the real pain people feel after training, swimming, or injury: inflammation, irritation, slow healing. We don’t just mask symptoms — we pull toxins and reduce swelling at the source.

How affiliates can earn
We run a simple, fair, performance-based affiliate program:

  • Commission rate: 20% on every sale generated
  • Average order value: $25–65 (higher with bundles)
  • Cookie duration: 30 days — if someone clicks your link and buys later, you still get paid
  • No cap — earn more as your audience grows

We also offer occasional performance bonuses:

  • Bonus % or flat fee for hitting sales milestones (e.g., 50+ orders in a month)
  • Free product kits for top performers

We track everything transparently through our affiliate platform (currently using Shopify + Refersion / UpPromote — dashboard access provided on acceptance).

How to promote us
We want content that feels authentic — not forced sales pitches. Here are the formats that convert best:

  1. Post-swim / post-workout recovery routine
    Show yourself applying the mask or paste right after training or pool time. Talk about skin feel, reduced redness, faster recovery.
  2. Before / after stories
    Real skin or swelling improvement (even 15–30 min difference is powerful).
  3. Pain-point storytelling
    “After chlorine, my skin was destroyed… here’s what actually fixed it.”
  4. Educational content
    Why clay works better than chemical creams / menthol / pills for real inflammation.
  5. Short Reels / TikToks / Stories 
    (15–30 seconds)Quick demo + personal result + link in bio / swipe-up.
  6. Bundles & discount codes
    We provide custom codes (e.g., YOURNAME15 for 15% off). Bundles (mask + recovery powder) convert very well.

Content guidelines:

  • Show real usage — no fake demos
  • Speak from your actual experience (or your followers’ results)
  • Tag @clayerworld and use #ClayerRecovery
  • Always link to https://clayerworld.com

We provide high-res product photos, before/after templates, swipe files, and sample scripts to make it easy.

Other information

  • We do not sell on Amazon 
    this protects your commission and keeps the brand premium
  • Returns: 
    30-day money-back guarantee — very low return rate due to real results
  • Exclusivity: 
    We do not mass-activate hundreds of affiliates. We prefer strong partnerships with aligned creators and professionals
  • Next steps: 
    If this fits your audience, reply with your Instagram/TikTok handle, rough follower count, and niche. We’ll send you the affiliate application link + starter kit details.

We’re looking for partners who care about real recovery and want to promote something that actually works — not just another supplement or cream.

If you’re ready to bring real healing to your people, let’s talk.

Looking forward to hearing from you.
